integrity: The proof uses exact differentiation, rational arithmetic, and a dependency-free polynomial identity check; no numerical trajectory or unverified asymptotic computation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the three published initial states used for the holonomic hyperchaos/sensitivity/Poincare calculations; it does not exclude hyperchaos for correctly initialized trajectories on the constraint manifold.
The off-sphere defect dynamics is an algebraic identity for the printed six-dimensional formula and is not asserted to be a physically meaningful constrained extension.
title: The showcased holonomic hyperchaos trajectories violate the tangent constraint at initialization
